dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello, I'm looking to purchase a new pair of shoes. I have a budget between $200 and $500 and I'm looking for shoes with at least a 5/5.0 average rating. Reviews are also important to me, so I'd like to know the number of reviews as well. The key qualities I'm looking for are comfort, cute style, and suitability for running. Could you please recommend some shoes that might fit my criteria?

I apologize, but I could not find any shoes in our inventory that match all of your criteria - comfortable, cute, suitable for running, priced between $200 and $500, and with a rating of 5 out of 5 stars. The closest I could find were shoes with a 4.5 star rating, but none that meet your full set of requirements.

Given your budget and desired features, may I suggest expanding your search to include shoes with a 4.5 star rating or higher? I'd be happy to provide more details on some highly rated options in that price range that may still meet your needs.

I'd like to take a closer look at those.

top_reviews.title: I put my new shoes on.....
top_reviews.text: I’m not a tennis shoe person but needed something to support and cushion my feet. Took a couple of weeks to break in but after that they are super comfortable. My chiropractor recommended these to me for back support

top_reviews.title: Worth the price
top_reviews.text: I have difficult feet. Fallen arch and bunnions. Finally I found these walking shoes that are totally comfortable. As a nurse I'm on my feet all day and at the end of the day I feel no pain and I could keep on going.

top_reviews.title: Great shoes!
top_reviews.text: Loved the way the shoe looked and the shape of the shoe. I am particular about how a running shoe fits and must come up above the back curve of my heel, which this shoe does perfectly. The shoe is super light and has plenty of cushion and arch support.
